# Appeal of Adverse Benefit Determination

**RE: Denial of Knee Arthroscopy / Meniscus Surgery (CPT 29881)**
**Member:** Casey Grant
**Member ID:** W903474664
**Plan:** CareSource (Commercial/ACA), West Virginia
**Reference Number:** POC-C29C7CFC4D-26579
**Date of Denial Notice:** 2026-08-15

Dear CareSource Appeals Department,

I am appealing the denial of my knee arthroscopy / meniscus surgery (CPT 29881), which was denied in the notice dated 2026-08-15, reference number POC-C29C7CFC4D-26579. My surgeon, Dr. Marchetti, has documented that this procedure is medically necessary, and I am asking CareSource to reconsider its decision.

The denial notice states that this determination was made under "the plan's applicable medical policy and clinical review criteria," but it does not name or quote the specific policy or criteria that were applied. I have not been able to independently locate the published criteria used to review this request. I understand that this type of musculoskeletal surgery review may be delegated to TurningPoint, and that TurningPoint's specific clinical criteria are not published for members. **I am formally requesting that CareSource, and/or its delegated reviewer TurningPoint, provide me in writing the exact medical necessity criteria that were applied to my request**, so that I and my surgeon can respond to the specific standard being used. I understand this may require CareSource or TurningPoint to identify my specific health plan in order to release the correct policy, and I am requesting that this be done as part of the appeal process.

Because I have not been given the specific quoted criteria the plan applied, I cannot map my records to plan language line by line. What I can do is lay out, in my own words, the relevant facts in my record, which I believe support medical necessity:

- **Duration and severity of symptoms:** I have had 14 months of progressive knee pain that has not improved with rest.
- **Conservative treatment already completed:** I completed 14 weeks of supervised physical therapy (24 visits, from 2026-03-27 to 2026-07-03) focused on quadriceps strengthening and range of motion, as documented in my physical therapy discharge note. I also used NSAIDs for 8 months without adequate relief, and had a corticosteroid injection on 2026-04-25 that gave only about 4 weeks of partial relief.
- **Imaging findings:** An MRI of my knee on 2026-07-19 showed a displaced bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus with mechanical locking. My articular cartilage was preserved, and I was graded Kellgren-Lawrence grade 1.
- **Functional limitations:** I experience locking and giving way in my knee. I cannot squat or kneel, and I am limited to walking on level surfaces.
- **Exam findings:** My exam showed positive provocative testing on the affected side, and my range of motion is limited by pain.
- **Other relevant history:** I have no active infection, no untreated substance use, a BMI of 29, and I do not smoke.

The denial states that "the imaging findings submitted do not support the medical necessity of the requested procedure." My MRI report describes a displaced bucket-handle tear with mechanical locking, which is a structural finding that my surgeon has determined, based on this imaging together with my symptoms, exam, and failed conservative treatment, warrants surgical repair. I am asking CareSource to explain, in light of these specific imaging findings, what additional information or criteria were found lacking, and to reconsider the determination in light of the fuller clinical picture summarized above.

**I respectfully request that CareSource:**
1. Provide, in writing, the specific medical necessity criteria (including any TurningPoint criteria) applied to this request;
2. Reconsider the denial in light of the clinical documentation summarized above; and
3. Issue a written determination on this appeal.

I understand that my appeal must be received by **2027-02-11** (within 180 days of the notice date), though I am relying on the date stated in my denial letter as authoritative. I am submitting this appeal through the My CareSource portal and/or by mail to: CareSource, Attention: Member Appeals, [P.O. Box / address as applicable to my state and plan]. I can also be reached by phone at the Member Services number on my ID card if additional information is needed.

Thank you for your time and reconsideration.

Sincerely,

______________________________
Casey Grant
Member ID: W903474664
Date: [date of submission]
Phone: [phone number]
Email: [email address]

**Enclosures:** [Physical therapy discharge note; MRI report dated 2026-07-19; corticosteroid injection record dated 2026-04-25; office/exam notes; surgeon's letter of medical necessity, if available]

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
